headline: Almost 3 in 5 Aussies who died between 2012 and 2022 were on welfare
snippet: A new report from the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare says that of the 287,000 people aged 22–64 who died between 2012 and 2022, almost three in five were receiving income support payments. Additionally, coronary heart disease was the leading cause of death among welfare recipients. However, the other leading causes of death differed depending on the type of payment received. The report also points out that these recipients were overrepresented in deaths from suicide, accidental poisonings and alcoholic liver disease.

headline: Features coming to Apple's foldable iPhone
snippet: After a long wait, Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone. The 'iPhone Duo' is compact when folded but transforms into a large 7.6-inch screen when unfolded. It features the powerful A20 Pro chip, an advanced camera, AI capabilities, a long-lasting battery, and multitasking features. Alongside this, the company has also unveiled the new iPhone 18 series, AirPods 5, and the Apple Watch. Apple's entry into the foldable market could further intensify competition with Samsung and Huawei.
